sentences.en: Instantly the girl saw her mother, she burst out crying.
sentences.zh: 1. 女孩一看到妈妈就哭了起来。

sentences.en: The boy had been crying until he got some candy.
sentences.zh: 2. 这个男孩直到得到了一些糖果才停止哭泣。

sentences.en: Crying loudly, the little girl hurried to the door.
sentences.zh: 3. 小女孩一边大声哭泣，一边急忙奔向门口。
